name: ECA
recent: ECA 正在推进一项私募计划，并已向 Bursa Securities 申请延长实施期限。公司最新季度营收同比增长 111.1%，但净利润环比下降 14.8%。近期新闻主要关注其股票交易动能。
notable: 公司就私募计划向 Bursa Securities 申请延长实施期限。
Bursa Securities 批准将私募计划的实施期限延长 6 个月至 2027 年 5 月 13 日。
risks: 私募计划可能带来股权摊薄。
私募计划尚未完成，公司需在延长期限内实施。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度（截至 7 月 31 日）营收为 1179.8 万令吉，同比增长 111.1%，环比增长 14.2%；净利润为 147.4 万令吉，环比下降 14.8%，净利率为 12.5%，低于上一季度的 16.7%。

recent_en: ECA is proceeding with a private placement and has applied to Bursa Securities for an extension of time to implement it. The company's latest quarterly revenue grew 111.1% year-on-year, while net profit declined 14.8% quarter-on-quarter. Recent news mainly focuses on its stock trading momentum.
notable_en: The company applied to Bursa Securities for an extension of time to implement its private placement.
Bursa Securities approved a 6-month extension until 13 May 2027 for the implementation of the private placement.
risks_en: The private placement may result in shareholding dilution.
The private placement is not yet completed and must be implemented within the extended timeframe.
earnings_en: For Q3 FY2026 (ended 31 July), revenue was MYR 11.798 million, up 111.1% year-on-year and 14.2% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 1.474 million, down 14.8% quarter-on-quarter, with a net margin of 12.5%, lower than 16.7% in the previous quarter.
